recentItems.title: "Big Physical Comedy to Very Heartfelt" Domhnall Gleeson on the Unique Tone of 'The Incomer'
recentItems.description:
Domhnall Gleeson sits down with Rotten Tomatoes editor Jacqueline Coley on the Rotten Tomatoes Awards Tour podcast to talk about his heartfelt Scottish comedy/drama, 'The Incomer'!  Gleeson talks about how incredibly important it was to wait until his co-stars, Grant O'Rourke and Gayle Rankin, were able to attach themselves to the project, how the film has an incredibly unique "weird" yet lovable tone, and he reminisces on old projects and teases some details about his upcoming ones!  See 'The Incomer' in theaters September 25!
